text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: GREETINGS! I'm Bamboo Memory, and I am here to RACE MY HEART OUT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're as energetic as ever, I see. Your training has clearly paid off.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking, Yaeno! You look great!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have you to thank for that. I've been looking forward to running with you today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall do everything in my power to defeat you—to express my gratitude for reigniting the fierce blaze in my heart…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And for being both a dear rival and one of my treasured adversaries.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: OHHHHH YEEEAH! That was an incredible challenge, Yaeno! You're on fire!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, I feel the same, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You believed in me and my dream to catch up to the person I admire! And today, I'll show you just how strong that dream is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're one of my precious rivals as well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: NOT YOU TOOOO! I don't think my heart can take all this HAPPINESS!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This's what I'm talkin' about! Your energy 'n' excitement's infectin' everyone! It's like a real festival 'round here now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Inari!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Inari's been getting a lot of attention for her own relentless pursuit of Oguri. She's like an old-school Edo fighter—she really packs a punch!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You and Oguri sure put on a show back at the Yasuda Kinen, but are you gonna be all right today?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Today's race is 2,200 meters. It's a totally different story from the Yasuda Kinen. You're not worried?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Sure. This distance isn't exactly my strong suit. But even so…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna use that as an excuse to back down! No way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm burning hot as the sun right now! And I'll use this heat to give you the race of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! Hell yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After all that talk, it's time to put our money where our mouths are. See ya on the track.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We're going to head over too. Let's make this an unforgettable race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to let you beat me, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll see you both out there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Oh MAN! I can't stop shaking!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still? You've been like this since yesterday. Get a grip already.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: City!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Gold City is not only a serious racer—she's also a very successful model. She never holds back, whether on the runway or the racetrack!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (She also happens to be my roommate! We've been together for a long time now!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I get that you're excited, but this race is incredibly important to me too, so could you not pretend I don't exist?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! There's no way I would do that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm just as excited that I get to run against you as I am anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But don't expect me to comfort you today just 'cause you're my roommate! I'll be too busy celebrating!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Have you literally ever seen me cry? Plus, it's not like you've ever had to comforted me before!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Two can play at that game—When you lose, don't think I'll let you turn our room into your own personal training dojo!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not like that'll happen anyway. I'm turning this course into my own personal catwalk.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not on my watch! Come at me with everything you got!
